proposal.observation: detected_lines.png: the 10 vertical (magenta) ring boundaries are all found (ring_count_error=0) and the outlier map shows clear chevron-shaped joint marks on every ring, so joint contrast is adequate. However oblique line yield is very low: only ~6 red and ~7 green short oblique segments across the whole 10-ring map, while blue horizontal fallback segments are far more numerous (>20) and scattered at unrelated heights. initial_prompt_points.png shows only 10 intersection points for 10 rings with irregular vertical spacing (y~1130, 1370, 1450, 1870, 3350, 3850) and a mix of 'assume', 'midpoint' and 'negative_slope' sources, i.e. most prompt centres are inferred rather than measured from oblique-line intersections. segmentation_results.png shows the consequence: the K/B/A block sequence is scrambled between rings (K blocks at different heights per ring, A blocks dominating the lower half). depth_map_viridis.png: NaN band from the removed top tube and arcs at the bottom are structural; depth_nan_ratio 0.229 is close to the dev reference (0.208), so depth holes are not the dominant issue. Weakest feature is correspondence_f1@15 = 0.337 (dev reference 0.446); sam_fill_rate 0.714 is only slightly below reference.
proposal.rule: d7 (stage_4_detection): m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered -> f_missing_lines. Preconditions per r_relax_hough checked: upstream f_joint_oversmoothed ruled out (joint chevrons and vertical joints are visible in the outlier map) and f_depth_holes is structural (tube shadow), not a hole-ratio anomaly, so the fix belongs in stage 4 rather than stages 2/3. d8 (m_spacing_regularity poor vs K/AB pattern) also fires secondarily, downstream of the missing oblique lines.
proposal.failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (primary), leading via inter_stage_dependencies to stage_4_detection.f_pattern_mismatch and stage_5_segmentation.f_crop_offset (block templates land off-segment, low correspondence_f1@15).
proposal.rationale: Stage 1 is locked (residual 3.0 cm < 10 cm gate), so unfolding keys are untouched. Denoising is deliberately left at the incumbent because Example 2 (degrade, g000) shows that narrowing mask_r to a ~4 cm band collapsed depth_nan_ratio to 0.93 and the proxy to 0.07; the current radial gate already gives ring_count_error=0 and a near-reference NaN ratio. hough_threshold_vertical is also left alone because the 10 vertical ring boundaries are already correct. The overlay follows the joint pattern of Example 1 (improve, s021: proxy 0.700->0.708, correspondence_f1@15 0.446->0.460 on the same complex family with expected_rings=10): low oblique Hough threshold (27) with a large oblique maxLineGap (74) to recover fragmented oblique joint segments, a high horizontal Hough threshold (60) with large horizontal maxLineGap (28) so the horizontal path only acts as a genuine fallback rather than flooding the intersection set, pattern_tolerance 11 to let the K/AB distance pattern accept slightly irregular centres, and a low enhancing curvature_threshold (~0.0004) as in that example. This is applied as an analogy of the joint outcome, not as per-parameter attribution. Expected response: more oblique lines and measured (not assumed) prompt centres, a more consistent K/B/A sequence per ring, higher correspondence_f1@15 with sam_fill_rate roughly unchanged and ring_count_error staying 0. All values are inside configs/bounds/complex.json.
